description_en: Queries the detailed information of an HBase instance by calling the DescribeInstance operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstance查询HBase实例的详细信息
name: DescribeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription)
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
实例是否自动续费，返回值：
true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

仅当PayType取值为Prepaid（包年包月）时，此参数有返回值

BackupStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup feature is supported. Valid values:
open: The backup feature is supported.
close: The backup feature is not supported
BackupStatus.description_zh:
表示是否支持备份功能，返回值：
open：支持备份功能。
close：不支持备份功能

ClusterType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
cluster: cluster edition.
single: single-node edition
ClusterType.description_zh:
实例类型，返回值：
cluster：集群版。
single：单节点

ColdStorageSize.description_en: The cold storage capacity. Unit: GB
ColdStorageSize.description_zh: 冷存储空间大小，单位为GB

ColdStorageStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the cold storage feature is supported. Valid values:
open: The cold storage feature is supported.
close: The cold storage feature is not supported
ColdStorageStatus.description_zh:
是否支持冷存储功能，返回值：
open：支持冷存储功能。
close：不支持冷存储功能

ConfirmMaintainTime.description_en:
Indicates whether the maintenance window of the instance has been confirmed for the first time. Valid values:
true: The maintenance window has been confirmed.
false: The maintenance window has not been confirmed.

The Confirm Maintenance Window dialog box appears only when you access the Basic Information page of the instance for the first time
ConfirmMaintainTime.description_zh:
是否首次确认实例的运维时间，返回值：
true：已确认。
false：未确认。

仅首次进入实例的基本信息页面会弹出首次确认实例的运维时间对话框

CoreDiskCount.description_en: The number of disks for core nodes

CoreDiskSize.description_en: The disk capacity of core nodes. Unit: GB

CoreDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of core nodes. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd: local HDD.
local__ssd: local SSD
CoreDiskType.description_zh:
Core节点磁盘类型，返回值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
local_hdd：本地HDD盘。
local__ssd：本地SSD盘

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

CreatedTimeUTC.description_en: The time when the instance was created, in UTC

Duration.description_en:
The auto-renewal period.

Monthly subscription: The auto-renewal period is one month.
Yearly subscription: The auto-renewal period is one year (12 months).

This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription)
Duration.description_zh:
自动续费周期。

按月购买：自动续费周期为1个月。
按年购买：自动续费周期为1年（12个月）。

仅当PayType取值为Prepaid（包年包月）时，此参数有返回值

EnableHbaseProxy.description_en:
Indicates whether access from the open-source HBase client is supported. Valid values:

true: Access is supported.

false: Access is not supported
EnableHbaseProxy.description_zh:
是否支持HBase开源客户端访问，返回值：

true：支持访问。

false：不支持访问

EncryptionKey.description_en:
The encryption key.

This parameter is returned when the encryption type is CloudDisk
EncryptionKey.description_zh:
加密的密钥。

加密类型为CloudDisk时返回此参数

EncryptionType.description_en:
The encryption type. Valid values:
NoEncryption: Encryption is disabled.
CloudDisk: Cloud disk encryption is enabled.
EncryptionKey: The encryption key specified by the parameter.

Cloud disk encryption cannot be disabled after it is enabled
EncryptionType.description_zh:
加密类型，返回值：
NoEncryption：不启用加密。
CloudDisk：云盘加密并返回。
EncryptionKey：参数指定加密的密钥。

云盘加密开启后无法关闭

Engine.description_en:
The database engine type. Valid values:
hbase: HBase Standard Edition or HBase Single-Node Edition.
hbaseue: HBase Enhanced Edition.
serverlesshbase: HBase Serverless Edition.
bds: BDS instance
Engine.description_zh:
数据引擎类型。
hbase：HBase标准版或HBase单机版。
hbaseue：HBase增强版。
serverlesshbase：HBaseServerless版。
bds：BDS实例

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires

ExpireTimeUTC.description_en: The time when the instance expires, in UTC

IsDeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled. Valid values:
true: Deletion protection is enabled.
false: Deletion protection is disabled
IsDeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否开启删除保护，返回值：
true：开启。
false：未开启

IsHa.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is configured for high availability. Valid values:
true: The instance is configured for high availability.
false: The instance is not configured for high availability.

The cluster edition is configured for high availability by default and uses two master nodes.
The single-node edition is configured with the actual available capacity
IsHa.description_zh:
实例是否配置为高可用，返回值：
true：配置为高可用。
false：未配置为高可用。

集群版默认配置为高可用，使用2个Master节点。
单节点配置为实际可用容量

IsLatestVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is of the latest version. Valid values:
true: The instance is of the latest version.
false: The instance is not of the latest version
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
实例是否为最新版本，返回值：
true：最新版本。
false：不是最新版本

IsMultiModel.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a multi-model cluster edition. Valid values:
true: The instance is a multi-model cluster edition.
false: The instance is not a multi-model cluster edition
IsMultiModel.description_zh:
实例是否为多模集群版，返回值：
true：是多模集群版。
false：不是多模集群版

LproxyMinorVersion.description_en: The minimum version of the LPROXY service

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the maintenance window for the instance

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the maintenance window for the instance

MasterDiskSize.description_en: The disk capacity of master nodes. Unit: GB
MasterDiskSize.description_zh: Master节点的磁盘容量，单位为GB

MasterDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of master nodes. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

This parameter is returned for single-node instances
MasterDiskType.description_zh:
Master节点的磁盘类型，返回值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。

单节点实例会返回此参数

MasterNodeCount.description_en:
The type of master nodes. Valid values:
0: The master node is a single node.
2: The master node is in cluster mode
MasterNodeCount.description_zh:
表示Master节点类型，返回值：
0表示Master节点为单节点。
2表示Master节点为集群版

MinorVersion.description_en: The minor version number of the instance

ModuleStackVersion.description_en: The version of the module type

NeedUpgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the components of the instance need to be upgraded. Valid values:
true: An upgrade is required.
false: No upgrade is required
NeedUpgrade.description_zh:
表示是否需要升级实例的组件，返回值：
true：升级。
false：不升级

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:
VPC: Virtual Private Cloud. If the network type is VPC, the VswitchId and VpcId parameters are returned.
CLASSIC: classic network
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值：
VPC：专有网络类型，如果为专有网络，则返回VswitchId和VpcId参数。
CLASSIC：经典网络类型

ParentId.description_en: The ID of the parent instance

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
实例的计费类型，返回值：

Prepaid：包年包月。
Postpaid：按量付费

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region in which the instance is deployed

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
CREATING: The instance is being created.
ACTIVATION: The instance is running.
DELETING: The instance is being deleted.
RESTARTING: The instance is being restarted.
MINOR_VERSION_TRANSING: A minor version upgrade is in progress
Status.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：
CREATING：创建中。
ACTIVATION：运行中。
DELETING：删除中。
RESTARTING：重启中。
MINOR_VERSION_TRANSING：小版本升级中

TaskProgress.description_en: The progress of a task that is running on the instance, in percentage (%). Tasks initiated from the ApsaraDB for HBase console include specification changes, node scaling out, node scaling in, instance restart, and minor version upgrade
TaskProgress.description_zh: 实例的任务运行进度，单位为百分比（%）。通过云数据库HBase控制台发起的任务，包括变更规格、扩容节点、缩容节点、重启实例，小版本升级等

TaskStatus.description_en:
running: The task is running.
pause: The task is paused.
fail: The task is interrupted.
finish: The task is completed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
running 运行中
pause 任务暂停
fail 任务中断
finish 已完成

VpcId.description_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID. This parameter is returned when NetworkType is 2
VpcId.description_zh: 专有网络ID，当NetworkType为2时会返回此参数

VswitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is returned when NetworkType is 2
VswitchId.description_zh: 虚拟交换机ID，当NetworkType为2时会返回此参数
